summary.content:
Today's selection covers 109 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 69 on Artificial Intelligence and 16 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, BleepingComputer, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, BBC Technology and others
• **Fresh Content**: 53 articles published in the last 24 hours
